Version: 8.0 Effective date: 14th Apr 2025 Page 3 of 11 Indegene Information Security Policy 1. Introduction Indegene is a Scientific and Commercialization Partner for leading Pharmaceutical and Healthcare companies across the world, specializing in Medical, Marketing, and Commercialization services. Indegene service lines include Business Enablers, Device Technology, Enterprise Commercial, Enterprise Medical, Enterprise Clinical, Growth Markets China. The value of Information assets used/ transmitted/ accessed/ processed across these service lines business process requirements critical to Indegene and hence the Information Security Management System framework naturally applies to our Business Needs. This document describes Indegene’s Information security Policy and how this will be implemented in the applicable scope. 2. Purpose and Scope of Information Security Policy Purpose: This policy defines the Information security policy of Indegene Limited, (Indegene). The policy establishes a framework for stating the commitment and setting the objectives and to provide direction and principles for establishing Information Security Management System of Indegene. The Information Security policy is committed to satisfy applicable requirements in relation to information security and is committed to continual improvement of the organization’s information Security Management System The intended outcome of Indegene’s Information Security Policy is to protect the organization's information assets by establishing guidelines and controls that ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability (CIA triad) of data. Scope: The scope of this policy applies to the management of Information Security that covers provisioning of Design, Development and Implementation of Software applications and solutions, Knowledge processing services, medical, safety and regulatory services, Healthcare service, end to end commercialization services, analytical services, training solutions, Learning and Development solutions and customer support management services and associated support functions. Definition of Information Security: Information security at Indegene encompasses the protection of areas that contain information and other associated assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction, ensuring that data remains confidential, accurate, and available as needed.

Policy Description Indegene is dedicated to safeguarding Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability of information, considering business strategy and requirements, regulations, legislation, contracts, and the current and projected information security risks and threats. Our commitment encompasses the following principles and objectives: Information Security Objectives: • Establish criteria for evaluating business risks. • Implement controls to protect the organization’s information from theft, abuse, misuse, and any form of damage. • Promote an appropriate level of awareness, knowledge, and skill among management and staff to minimize the occurrence and severity of information security incidents. • Ensure business continuity in the event of significant information security incidents leading to disruption of business activities.

Version: 8.0 Effective date: 14th Apr 2025 Page 5 of 11 Indegene Information Security Policy Indegene aims to achieve its Information Security Objectives through a combination of strategic planning, policies, controls, and continuous improvement which are summarized below: • Establish a Strong Governance Framework • Risk Management & Assessment • Implement Security Controls & Best Practices • Ensure Compliance with Regulations & Standards • Foster a Security-Aware Culture • Establish an Incident Response & Business Continuity Plan • Continuously Monitor & Improve Security Posture Guiding Principles for Information Security • Commitment to satisfy applicable requirements related to information security, including legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual obligations. • Commitment to continual improvement of the information security management system to address evolving risks and threats. • Promotion of a culture that supports information security through regular training and awareness programs. Assignment of Responsibilities Defined roles and responsibilities for information security management include: • Senior management’s responsibility for providing strategic direction and ensuring alignment with business objectives • The Information Security Governance (ISG) group is tasked with implementing and maintaining the information security management system • All employees are responsible for adhering to information security policies and procedures, and to implement information security measures in accordance with the established Information Security Policy, and related procedural guidelines. Managing Exemptions and Exceptions Handling exemptions and exceptions to information security policies include: • Requests for exemptions must be submitted in writing to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) • Each request will be evaluated based on its merits and potential impact on the organization • Approved exemptions will be documented, and compensating controls will be implemented as necessary • By adhering to these principles and objectives, Indegene aims to exceed the expectations of interested parties and ensure robust information security management across the organization.

Version: 8.0 Effective date: 14th Apr 2025 Page 6 of 11 Indegene Information Security Policy Note: This policy should be read in conjunction with Indegene's Personal Data Privacy Policy 4. Senior Management Approval This policy governs the management and implementation of information security, encompassing people, processes, and technologies. It is reviewed and approved by the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). 5. Application of this policy This policy shall be made available to all employees, contractors, various business stakeholders. All personnel shall be made aware of Indegene’s Information Security expectations through planned training, awareness sessions and various methods of communication such as emailers, annual refresher training, etc. Indegene’s employees, including third-party personnel are expected to achieve a level of awareness of information security relevant to their roles and responsibilities in accordance with Indegene’s Information Security and Privacy Acceptable Use Policy. 6. Establishing and Maintaining External Security Collaborations The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities (such as CERT-In), special interest groups (such as ISO), specialist security forums (such as NIST), and professional associations (such as EY compliance) to enhance its security posture and ensure compliance with evolving regulations. These connections provide access to the latest threat intelligence, best practices, and industry developments, helping the organization stay ahead of potential security risks. Engaging with regulatory bodies ensures adherence to legal requirements, while collaboration with law enforcement and cybercrime units facilitates a swift response to security incidents. 7. Information Security Policy Violation Any breach or violation of Indegene Information Security policy will attract disciplinary actions as per the Indegene’s Policy. 8.
